subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dishevelled
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Dishevelled'** means something that is untidy, messy, or in disorder. (बेतरतीब)

 
 
• **Example:** After the long journey, his hair was** dishevelled** and his clothes were wrinkled.
 
 
 
• **'Tidy'** refers to something that is neatly arranged, organized, and in good order. (साफ़-सुथरा)
 
 
• **Example:** She always keeps her room** tidy **and everything in its place.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Dishevelled'** is **'Tidy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Tidy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Assertive** (आत्मविश्वासी): Having a confident and forceful personality.

 
 
• **Example:** She is very** assertive** in meetings and always speaks her mind.
 
 
 
• **Tainted** (दाग़दार): Contaminated or spoiled.
 
 
• **Example:** The scandal **tainted** his reputation forever.
 
 
 
• **Rigid** (कठोर): Not flexible; strict.
 
 
• **Example:** The rules of the institution are very **rigid** and must be followed strictly.
 
 

1e5:T991,

The correct answer is **Option 2**
